stored_text.note: official.html is the Japanese 'About AISI' page (mandate, history, tasks, director). document-2.pdf is AISI's Japanese overview deck dated 2026-07-01 and document-1.pdf its English counterpart of the same date. The record describes a body, so there is no founding legal instrument; these pages are the issuer's own descriptions. The IPA press release (secondary) was not stored (HTTP 404).

english_version.note: J-AISI publishes its own English overview deck alongside the Japanese one (same date, 2026-07-01), with no 'provisional translation' label, and the About page links an English version. As there is no legal text, 'authentic' here means the issuer's own English edition of its self-description.

title.source_quote: AIセーフティ・インスティテュート（AISI）について
title.why: original_title is the institute's name as written in the Japanese deck (the About page writes it with half-width brackets: 'AIセーフティ・インスティテュート (AISI)'). The body's official English name in the stored English deck is 'Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI)'; the register adds 'Establishment of', a descriptive prefix for a body record rather than part of any official title. Acceptable, but not an official title.

summary_claims.claim: Japan's AI Safety Institute, the central government body for AI safety.
summary_claims.original_quote: 「統合イノベーション戦略2024」（2024年6月4日閣議決定）に基づき、AISIはAI安全性の中心的機関としてIPAに設置され
summary_claims.literal_translation: Based on the 'Integrated Innovation Strategy 2024' (Cabinet decision of 4 June 2024), AISI is established within IPA as the central institution for AI safety

summary_claims.claim: It develops and promotes methods and standards for evaluating AI safety.
summary_claims.original_quote: AIセーフティ・インスティテュート (AISI)は、安全・安心で信頼できるAIの実現に向けて、AIの安全性に関する評価手法や基準の検討・推進を行うための機関です。
summary_claims.literal_translation: The AI Safety Institute (AISI) is a body for examining and promoting evaluation methods and standards concerning AI safety, toward the realisation of safe, secure and trustworthy AI.

summary_claims.claim: It cooperates with counterpart institutes such as those of the UK and US.
summary_claims.original_quote: ３．他国の関係機関（英米のAI Safety Institute等）との国際連携に関する業務
summary_claims.literal_translation: 3. Work on international cooperation with related bodies of other countries (the UK and US AI Safety Institutes, etc.)

key_terms.note: Official English name from the stored English deck (document-1.pdf, page 1).

key_terms.original: 中心的機関 (About page) / 中心機関 (deck, page 4)
key_terms.register_rendering: the central government body for AI safety
key_terms.official_rendering: the central institution for AI Safety in Japan
key_terms.note: The English deck (page 4) says 'J-AISI is designated as the central institution for AI Safety in Japan.' The Japanese deck (page 7) calls AISI a 政府関係機関 ('government-related organization') whose secretariat sits in IPA. 'Central government body' can be read as 'a body of the central government', which slightly overstates its status.
Used in notes for the Executive Director (所長 村上 明子（非常勤）).

issues: Summary calls AISI 'the central government body for AI safety'; the source says 中心的機関 ('central institution', as in J-AISI's own English deck) and describes AISI as a government-related organisation housed in IPA.
Title prefix 'Establishment of' is the register's own; the official English name is 'Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI)'.
'Develops' renders 検討 ('examine, study'); the Japanese describes AISI as examining and promoting evaluation methods and standards, which is slightly weaker.
note: Notes (announcement by PM Kishida at the AI Strategy Council on 21 Dec 2023, launch on 14 Feb 2024, Executive Director Akiko Murakami part-time) match official.html. The English deck names IPA inconsistently ('Innovation Platform Agency（IPA）' on pages 7 and 10, 'IT Promotion Agency, Japan (IPA)' on page 8); the register uses the name in the site footer, 'Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan（IPA）'. No web search was needed.
